Vendored as a plain copy (no submodule) under third_party/locagent/, with
.git stripped. Update this file's commit hash if the vendored copy is ever
re-synced to a newer upstream commit.

Scoring entry points used by token_sniper (see
token_sniper/evaluation/locagent_scoring.py):
  - third_party/locagent/evaluation/eval_metric.py
    - evaluate_results(loc_file, level2key_dict, dataset, split, ...)
    - cal_metrics_w_dataset(...)
  - third_party/locagent/util/utils.py: load_jsonl(...)

Note: evaluate_results/cal_metrics_w_dataset (the dataset-keyed scoring
path, used here) take no filter_list argument and never apply the
26-instance `filtered_instances` exclusion list defined at the top of
eval_metric.py -- that list is only wired into the separate
cal_metrics_w_file/eval_w_file functions, which this project does not use.

third_party/locagent/evaluation/loc_output/locagent/claude_3-5/loc_outputs.jsonl
ships LocAgent's own published Lite-274 predictions (Claude 3.5 agent),
used as the sanity-check target in scripts/verify_locagent_baseline.py.

## Python version note

eval_metric.py uses a Python-3.12+-only f-string quirk (nested identical
quotes) in two lines of its unused `docs`-key branch -- this fails to
*parse* (SyntaxError) under this repo's Python >=3.11 floor, so it can't be
imported in-process. Rather than patch the vendored file, it runs isolated:

    /usr/local/bin/python3.13 -m venv third_party/locagent/.venv
    third_party/locagent/.venv/bin/pip install pandas torch datasets

token_sniper/evaluation/locagent_scoring.py shells out to that venv via
third_party/_run_locagent_scoring.py (glue code, kept outside
third_party/locagent/ so the vendored tree itself stays untouched). The
.venv/ directory is gitignored (matches LocAgent's own `.venv` gitignore
rule) -- recreate it with the two commands above after a fresh clone.
